types.label: Approval pop-up in the console
types.description: With Follow Amber on, a held or confirm call pops up in the console. A call an active pass covers runs at once and never pops up. The veto banner and AmberX still show a waiting call when this is off.

types.label: Ran under pass (quiet line)
types.description: One quiet line in the console when a call ran under an approval pass: the tool and the pass id. Only sent while the pass setting quietNotice is on; off by default, a covered run sends nothing.
